an4.197:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an4.197:1.2: Atha kho Mallikā devī yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Mallikā devī Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.197:2.1: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇo ca hoti durūpo supāpiko dassanāya
an4.197:2.2: daliddo ca hoti appassako appabhogo appesakkho ca?
an4.197:3.1: Ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇo . . . dassanāya
an4.197:3.2: aḍḍho ca hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo mahesakkho ca?
an4.197:4.1: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacco mātugāmo abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato
an4.197:4.2: daliddo ca hoti appassako appabhogo appesakkho ca?
an4.197:5.1: Ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacco mātugāmo abhirūpo ca hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato aḍḍho ca hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo mahesakkho cāti? 2.
an4.197:6.1: Idha Mallike ekacco mātugāmo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo
an4.197:6.2: appam pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an4.197:6.3: Sā na dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthuṃ yānaṃ mālaṃ gandhaṃ vilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ,
an4.197:6.6: Sā ce tato cutā itthattaṃ āgacchati sā yattha yattha paccājāyati dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya
an4.197:6.7: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca. 3.
an4.197:7.1: Idha pāna Mallike ekacco mātugāmo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo
an4.197:7.2: appam pi vutto . . . patitthīyati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an4.197:7.3: Sā dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ . . . seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ,
an4.197:7.5: parilābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na issati na upadussati na issaṃ bandhati.
an4.197:7.6: Sā ce tato cutā itthattaṃ āgacchati sā yattha yattha paccājāyati dubbaṇṇā hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya
an4.197:8.1: Idha pana Mallike ekacco mātugāmo akodhano hoti anupāyāsabahulo
an4.197:8.2: bahum pi vuttā samāno nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca na pātukaroti.
an4.197:8.3: Sā na dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ . . . seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ,
an4.197:8.6: Sā ce tato cutā itthattaṃ āgacchati sā yattha yattha paccājāyati abhirūpā ca hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā
an4.197:9.1: Idha Mallike ekacco mātugāmo akodhano hoti anupāyāsabahulo
an4.197:9.2: bahum pi vuttā samāno nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati . . . na pātukaroti.
an4.197:9.3: Sā dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ . . . seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ,
an4.197:9.5: paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na issati na upadussati na issaṃ bandhati.
an4.197:9.6: Sā ce tato cutā itthattaṃ āgacchati sā yattha yattha paccājāyati abhirūpā ca hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā
an4.197:9.7: aḍḍhā ca hoti mahaddhanā . . . mahesakkhā ca. 6.
an4.197:10.1: Ayaṃ kho Mallike hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacco mātugamo dubbaṇṇo ca hoti . . . appesakkho
an4.197:10.5: Ayaṃ kho Mallike hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇo ca hoti . . . mahesakkho
an4.197:10.7: Ayaṃ pana Mallike hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacco mātugāmo abhirūpo ca hoti . . . appesakkho ca. Ayaṃ pana Mallike hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacco
an4.197:10.8: mātugāmo abhirūpo ca hoti . . . mahesakkhā cāti. 7.
an4.197:11.1: Evaṃ vutte Mallikā devī Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.197:11.2: Yan nūnāhaṃ bhante aññaṃ jātiṃ kodhanā ahosiṃ upāyāsabahulā
an4.197:11.3: appam pi vuttā samānā abhisajjiṃ kuppiṃ vyāpajjiṃ patitthīyiṃ kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātvākāsiṃ,
an4.197:11.4: sā 'haṃ bhante etarahi dubbaṇṇā durūpā supāpikā dassanīyā.
an4.197:12.1: Yan nūnāhaṃ bhante aññaṃ jātiṃ adāsiṃ samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā . . . seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ, sā 'haṃ bhante etarahi aḍḍhā ca mahaddhanā mahābhogā.
an4.197:13.1: Yan nūnāhaṃ bhante aññaṃ jātiṃ anissamānikā ahosiṃ paralābha . . . pūjanāsu na issiṃ na upadussiṃ na issaṃ bandhiṃ, sāhaṃ bhante etarahi mahesakkhā.
an4.197:13.2: Santi kho pana bhante imasmiṃ rājakule khattiyakaññā pi brāhmaṇakaññā pi gahapatikaññā pi, tāsāhaṃ issarādhipaccaṃ kāremi
an4.197:13.3: esāhaṃ bhante ajjatagge akodhanā bhavissāmi anupāyāsabahulā
an4.197:13.4: bahum pi vuttā samānā nābhisajjissāmi na kuppissāmi na vyāpajjissāmi na patitthiyyissāmi na kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukarissāmi,
an4.197:13.5: dassāmi samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ . . . seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ,
an4.197:13.6: anissamānikā bhavissāmi, paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na ississāmi na upadussissāmi na issaṃ bandhissāmi.
an4.197:13.7: Abhikkantaṃ bhante abhikkantaṃ bhante . . . Upāsikaṃ bhante Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pānupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti. 198. 1.
